The facility maintains 19 specialized ground service teams available for deployment. Each team operates under continuous duty cycles constrained by regulatory limitations to 480 minutes maximum service duration to ensure operational safety and personnel welfare. Relocation of service teams between aircraft positions incurs temporal overhead expenses encompassing airfield transit duration and equipment reconfiguration intervals. The airport operations management seeks to optimize the allocation of all 35 service interventions across the 19 available teams to minimize cumulative temporal expenditure associated with team repositioning, while maintaining compliance with operational protocols: 1. Each service intervention must be exclusively assigned to a single team. 2. Interventions allocated to identical teams must be temporally segregated without temporal overlap. 3. from ortools.sat.python import cp_model
import numpy as np
import json

def create_model():
    """Create and solve the ground service team optimization problem."""
    
    n_interventions = 35
    n_teams = 19
    max_duration = 480
    
    start_times = [
        1.0, 14.0, 60.0, 97.0, 134.0, 138.0, 143.0, 144.0, 220.0, 231.0,
        264.0, 301.0, 324.0, 342.0, 402.0, 405.0, 410.0, 414.0, 419.0, 445.0,
        461.0, 499.0, 541.0, 553.0, 554.0, 574.0, 576.0, 632.0, 656.0, 674.0,
        711.0, 766.0, 775.0, 871.0, 886.0
    ]
    
    end_times = [
        144.0, 217.0, 212.0, 118.0, 365.0, 325.0, 272.0, 364.0, 255.0, 400.0,
        478.0, 531.0, 444.0, 534.0, 576.0, 465.0, 462.0, 463.0, 507.0, 606.0,
        652.0, 724.0, 693.0, 747.0, 615.0, 689.0, 708.0, 691.0, 726.0, 786.0,
        765.0, 791.0, 882.0, 951.0, 927.0
    ]
    
    transition = np.full((n_interventions, n_interventions), float('inf'))
    
    transitions = [
        (0, 8, 16.9), (0, 9, 13.1), (0, 6, 23.69),
        (1, 11, 15.5), (1, 15, 34.6), (1, 16, 30.0), (1, 7, 24.09),
        (2, 11, 21.9), (2, 12, 24.5), (2, 14, 27.4), (2, 15, 31.9),
        (2, 16, 36.0), (2, 17, 34.7), (2, 8, 23.79),
        (3, 8, 18.7), (3, 9, 17.8), (3, 10, 28.7), (3, 11, 28.8),
        (3, 12, 39.0), (3, 13, 34.9), (3, 14, 52.9), (3, 15, 46.2),
        (3, 16, 58.6), (3, 17, 47.1), (3, 4, 25.29),
        (4, 17, 7.7),
        (5, 13, 13.0), (5, 14, 12.1), (5, 15, 10.9), (5, 18, 25.29),
        (6, 13, 14.8), (6, 14, 20.3), (6, 15, 15.4), (6, 16, 17.0),
        (6, 17, 25.4), (6, 18, 30.7), (6, 11, 24.79),
        (7, 15, 9.1),
        (8, 10, 6.1), (8, 13, 20.3), (8, 14, 23.6), (8, 15, 29.7),
        (8, 16, 28.5), (8, 17, 34.2), (8, 18, 30.3), (8, 20, 42.7),
        (8, 22, 56.0), (8, 23, 57.1), (8, 9, 24.79),
        (9, 18, 8.2), (9, 20, 24.5), (9, 22, 16.3), (9, 23, 30.3),
        (9, 24, 32.7),
        (10, 19, 2.6), (10, 24, 14.2), (10, 25, 26.79),
        (11, 21, 2.3), (11, 24, 8.3),
        (12, 20, 12.8), (12, 21, 20.9), (12, 22, 17.0), (12, 23, 17.5),
        (12, 24, 18.4), (12, 25, 28.0), (12, 26, 23.8), (12, 20, 26.49),
        (13, 21, 2.2), (13, 27, 27.29),
        (14, 29, 30.1), (14, 18, 26.59),
        (15, 20, 13.7), (15, 21, 14.4), (15, 22, 12.5), (15, 26, 21.7),
        (15, 27, 27.8), (15, 28, 30.5), (15, 21, 26.89),
        (16, 18, 5.8), (16, 20, 15.2), (16, 22, 15.0), (16, 24, 18.1),
        (16, 26, 23.2), (16, 22, 27.19),
        (17, 21, 17.0), (17, 22, 9.7), (17, 25, 20.6), (17, 23, 27.39),
        (18, 22, 4.8), (18, 25, 19.0),
        (19, 29, 28.6), (19, 24, 27.79),
        (20, 29, 22.0),
        (21, 29, 29.8),
        (22, 30, 12.4), (22, 31, 19.3),
        (23, 30, 18.1), (23, 31, 26.5),
        (24, 28, 16.0), (24, 30, 30.4),
        (25, 30, 10.4), (25, 29, 28.99),
        (26, 30, 8.6),
        (27, 31, 22.6), (27, 32, 17.1), (27, 30, 29.49),
        (28, 32, 10.1), (28, 31, 29.39),
        (29, 32, 17.1),
        (30, 32, 30.59),
        (31, 33, 30.69)
    ]
    
    for i, j, t in transitions:
        i_int = int(i)
        j_int = int(j)
        if transition[i_int, j_int] == float('inf'):
            transition[i_int, j_int] = t
        else:
            transition[i_int, j_int] = min(transition[i_int, j_int], t)
    
    model = cp_model.CpModel()
    
    assignment = {}
    for i in range(n_interventions):
        for k in range(n_teams):
            assignment[(i, k)] = model.NewBoolVar(f"assign_{i}_{k}")
    
    succ = {}
    for i in range(n_interventions):
        for j in range(n_interventions):
            if i != j and transition[i, j] < float('inf'):
                for k in range(n_teams):
                    succ[(i, j, k)] = model.NewBoolVar(f"succ_{i}_{j}_{k}")
    
    succ_start = {}
    succ_end = {}
    for k in range(n_teams):
        for i in range(n_interventions):
            succ_start[(i, k)] = model.NewBoolVar(f"start_{i}_{k}")
            succ_end[(i, k)] = model.NewBoolVar(f"end_{i}_{k}")
    
    team_start = [model.NewIntVar(0, int(max(start_times)), f"team_start_{k}") 
                  for k in range(n_teams)]
    team_end = [model.NewIntVar(0, int(max(end_times)), f"team_end_{k}") 
                for k in range(n_teams)]
    
    intervention_start_vars = [model.NewIntVar(int(start_times[i]), int(start_times[i]), 
                                               f"start_{i}") for i in range(n_interventions)]
    intervention_end_vars = [model.NewIntVar(int(end_times[i]), int(end_times[i]), 
                                             f"end_{i}") for i in range(n_interventions)]
    
    for i in range(n_interventions):
        model.Add(sum(assignment[(i, k)] for k in range(n_teams)) == 1)
    
    for i in range(n_interventions):
        for j in range(n_interventions):
            if i != j and transition[i, j] < float('inf'):
                for k in range(n_teams):
                    model.AddImplication(succ[(i, j, k)], assignment[(i, k)])
                    model.AddImplication(succ[(i, j, k)], assignment[(j, k)])
                    
                    model.Add(intervention_start_vars[j] >= intervention_end_vars[i] + int(transition[i, j])).OnlyEnforceIf(succ[(i, j, k)])
    
    for k in range(n_teams):
        for i in range(n_interventions):
            incoming = []
            for j in range(n_interventions):
                if i != j and transition[j, i] < float('inf'):
                    incoming.append(succ.get((j, i, k), None))
            incoming = [x for x in incoming if x is not None]
            
            outgoing = []
            for j in range(n_interventions):
                if i != j and transition[i, j] < float('inf'):
                    outgoing.append(succ.get((i, j, k), None))
            outgoing = [x for x in outgoing if x is not None]
            
        for i in range(n_interventions):
            incoming = []
            for j in range(n_interventions):
                if i != j and transition[j, i] < float('inf'):
                    incoming.append(succ.get((j, i, k), None))
            incoming = [x for x in incoming if x is not None]
            incoming.append(succ_start[(i, k)])
            
            outgoing = []
            for j in range(n_interventions):
                if i != j and transition[i, j] < float('inf'):
                    outgoing.append(succ.get((i, j, k), None))
            outgoing = [x for x in outgoing if x is not None]
            outgoing.append(succ_end[(i, k)])
            
            model.Add(sum(incoming) == assignment[(i, k)])
            model.Add(sum(outgoing) == assignment[(i, k)])
        
        team_used = model.NewBoolVar(f"team_used_{k}")
        interventions_assigned = [assignment[(i, k)] for i in range(n_interventions)]
        model.Add(sum(interventions_assigned) >= 1).OnlyEnforceIf(team_used)
        model.Add(sum(interventions_assigned) == 0).OnlyEnforceIf(team_used.Not())
        
        start_vars = [succ_start[(i, k)] for i in range(n_interventions)]
        model.Add(sum(start_vars) == 1).OnlyEnforceIf(team_used)
        model.Add(sum(start_vars) == 0).OnlyEnforceIf(team_used.Not())
        
        end_vars = [succ_end[(i, k)] for i in range(n_interventions)]
        model.Add(sum(end_vars) == 1).OnlyEnforceIf(team_used)
        model.Add(sum(end_vars) == 0).OnlyEnforceIf(team_used.Not())
    
    for k in range(n_teams):
        assigned_interventions = [assignment[(i, k)] for i in range(n_interventions)]
        
        for i in range(n_interventions):
            model.Add(team_start[k] <= intervention_start_vars[i]).OnlyEnforceIf(assignment[(i, k)])
            model.Add(team_end[k] >= intervention_end_vars[i]).OnlyEnforceIf(assignment[(i, k)])
        
        model.Add(team_end[k] - team_start[k] <= max_duration)
    
    total_transition = model.NewIntVar(0, 10000, "total_transition")
    transition_terms = []
    for i in range(n_interventions):
        for j in range(n_interventions):
            if i != j and transition[i, j] < float('inf'):
                for k in range(n_teams):
                    transition_terms.append(int(transition[i, j]) * succ[(i, j, k)])
    
    model.Add(total_transition == sum(transition_terms))
    model.Minimize(total_transition)
    
    solver = cp_model.CpSolver()
    solver.parameters.max_time_in_seconds = 300.0
    solver.parameters.num_search_workers = 8
    solver.parameters.log_search_progress = False
    
    status = solver.Solve(model)
    
    if status in (cp_model.OPTIMAL, cp_model.FEASIBLE):
        total_travel = 0.0
        for i in range(n_interventions):
            for j in range(n_interventions):
                if i != j and transition[i, j] < float('inf'):
                    for k in range(n_teams):
                        if (i, j, k) in succ and solver.Value(succ[(i, j, k)]) == 1:
                            total_travel += transition[i, j]
        
        crews_list = []
        for k in range(n_teams):
            assigned = [i for i in range(n_interventions) if solver.Value(assignment[(i, k)]) == 1]
            if assigned:
                first = None
                for i in assigned:
                    has_incoming = any(
                        (j, i, k) in succ and solver.Value(succ[(j, i, k)]) == 1
                        for j in assigned if j != i
                    )
                    if not has_incoming:
                        first = i
                        break
                sequence = []
                current = first
                while current is not None:
                    sequence.append(current)
                    nxt = None
                    for j in assigned:
                        if j != current and (current, j, k) in succ and solver.Value(succ[(current, j, k)]) == 1:
                            nxt = j
                            break
                    current = nxt
                crews_list.append(sequence)
        
        print(json.dumps({
            "crews": crews_list,
            "total_travel_time": round(total_travel, 2)
        }))
    else:
        print(json.dumps({"crews": [], "total_travel_time": 0.0}))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    create_model()
